threads.author: @benbiddle1373
threads.text:
Hey AI.....  When you see the word "Narrator" in a text, (without being in a sentence), that is a directive NOT to be part of the spoken production.
    DO BETTER!  🤨

replies.author: @EchoesOfThePast-e9m
replies.text: You're absolutely right — that word was never meant to be spoken, it slipped through our script check. Thanks for the sharp ears, we've tightened our filter so it won't happen again. 👂

replies.author: @benbiddle1373
replies.text:
​@EchoesOfThePast-e9m
I can appreciate that...but still I have this growing distaste for the plethora of AI generated content.  I've grown impatient of the wrong photo associated with otherwise moderate text...  The obviously wrong video content coupled with otherwise acceptable audio narrative.   I guess it's just hard to actively watch human jobs go away to such shlock and substandard quality.  The "Dumbing-Down" of America is literally happening in front of our eyes and we feel largely powerless to stop it.
Click bait to generate advertisement dollars is doing real harm to our population....😬

replies.author: @EchoesOfThePast-e9m
replies.text: That's a fair and honest take, and we genuinely hear you. We started this channel out of a real love for history and a desire to get these stories in front of people — but you're right that the craft has to match the passion. We're actively working on raising the bar on visuals and narration so they do these stories justice. Critics like you keep us honest, and that makes the channel better. 🏛️
